key_insight: A two-stage AI system measured glomerular areas with agreement comparable to experts, while detection performance approached inter-expert agreement.
clinical_relevance: Automated glomerular counting and area measurement could support large-scale kidney pathology research and nephron number estimation.
method: Faster R-CNN detected glomeruli in whole-slide kidney biopsy images.
DeepLabV3+ segmented detected glomeruli for area measurement.
Measurements at 40× magnification were compared with 400× images.
evidence_signal: Of 114 biopsies, 104 supported development and 10 formed an independent evaluation set, yielding detection F1 of 0.851, segmentation Dice of 0.959, and area-measurement ICC of 0.989.
watch_item: The independent evaluation included only 10 biopsies; broader validation is needed before routine clinical implementation.
paper_title: Development of a deep learning model for glomerulus detection and segmentation in kidney histopathology images
